- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.25) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices during low sentiment (sentiment < 0.15) — add 3–7% to forecast to compensate for mean reversion bias.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes (e.g., >10% from prior day) — cap forecast at 10% below true peak.
- Lagged price movements (forecast 30d vs true 30d) — adjust for 1–2 day lag in model response; add 2–5% to forecast for early days.
- Mean reversion bias in high volatility periods — reduce forecast by 3–8% for days with sentiment < 0.10 or > 0.80.
- Avoid overfitting to recent highs — if last 3 days are > 75% of 30d mean, reduce forecast by 5–10% to prevent overshoot.
